title: Saggar Barrel Firing
evidence_sentence: A two-part alternative firing workshop where participants prepare pots in clay-lined saggars, load a barrel, fire overnight, and unwrap cooled pieces the next afternoon.
evidence_quote: Prepare pots in a clay-lined saggar before loading and igniting the barrel firing. Return the next afternoon to lift your pots from the cooled ashes, unwrap then polish to reveal their overnight transformation.
summary: A two-part saggar barrel firing workshop: Friday evening you prepare clay saggars around your pots with combustible materials and enjoy a pizza supper while firing; Saturday you unwrap and polish the finished pieces. Bring up to 2 bisqueware pieces or purchase studio pots.
bring: Maximum 2 bisqueware pieces (max 12cm x 15cm) or purchase available pots at £10 each
